summary: Query and export photos from Apple Photos.app, including metadata, albums, and faces.

recipes.label: Export Photos by Album
recipes.description: Export all photos in a specific album to a folder.

fields.name: album
fields.label: Album Name
fields.optionsCommand: osxphotos albums | awk '/^albums:/{f=1;next} /^shared albums:/{f=0} f && /^  /{line=$0; sub(/^  /,"",line); sub(/: [0-9]+$/,"",line); print line}'

recipes.label: Export Photos by Keyword
recipes.description: Export all photos tagged with a specific keyword.

recipes.label: Export Photos by Date Range
recipes.description: Export photos taken between two dates.

recipes.label: Find Duplicate Photos
recipes.description: List photos that appear to be duplicates based on content hash.

recipes.label: Export Photos of a Person
recipes.description: Export all photos containing a specific recognized face.

fields.name: personName
fields.label: Person Name
fields.optionsCommand: osxphotos persons | awk '/^persons:/{f=1;next} f && /^  /{line=$0; sub(/^  /,"",line); sub(/: [0-9]+$/,"",line); print line}'

recipes.label: List All Albums
recipes.description: Show every album in the Photos library.

recipes.label: Best Photos of a Place
recipes.description: Export the top-scored photos taken in a specific city or location, ranked by Apple's on-device aesthetic score. "Top 20%" means the best 20% within that place, not the whole library.

recipes.label: Best Photos of a Person
recipes.description: Export the top-scored photos of a specific recognized face, ranked by Apple's on-device aesthetic score.

fields.name: personName
fields.label: Person Name
fields.optionsCommand: osxphotos persons | awk '/^persons:/{f=1;next} f && /^  /{line=$0; sub(/^  /,"",line); sub(/: [0-9]+$/,"",line); print line}'

recipes.label: Best Photos of a Year
recipes.description: Export the top-scored photos from a specific year, useful for building a "best of" recap without manually sorting through everything.
